balls.text: length ball outside off. Cummins flat-bats it past the bowler and comes back for the second
a yorker but Cummins watches it closely, jams his bat it and plays the nutmeg past square leg for four
a length ball outside off and Cummins goes aerial towards long-off. Tim David wasn't exactly at the boundary line and the ball just clears him
full outside off. Steered towards point where the fielder fumbles and concedes an extra run
full and wide. Steered towards backward point
length ball outside off. Cummins drags it towards deep midwicket
length but way, way outside off. A wide even though Cummins moved across
misses his mark this time and ends up bowling a low full toss. Cummins pushes it towards long-off
another yorker. Sanvir manages to dig it out towards deep midwicket
Bumrah targets the stumps but Cummins gets his bat on it this time and picked up a single towards point
the fast yorker this time. Cummins pushes at it and gets beaten. Just misses the off stump
slower and full outside off. Cummins spots it and opens the face of the bat to steer it between the keeper and short third for a much-needed boundary
slower and full outside off. Pushed towards sweeper cover
length outside off. Sanvir drills it to the right of extra cover where Surya throws himself and makes the stop to keep it to just one
slower length ball again but too wide this time. Sanvir doesn't chase it
slower once more. Cummins hits it towards long-off
again slower. Length ball wide outside off. Sanvir chops the cut into the pitch
a slower length ball outside off. Drags it wide of long-on and sprints back for the second
a beamer. Cummins does well to protect himself and gets some bat on it. It goes over short fine leg. Bumrah chases it and stops it just inside but cannot stop the third
full outside off, another slower one. Sanvir drills it towards long-off
A slower one, full outside off. Cummins steers it behind point

Given lbw. A length ball on the stumps. Samad was looking to work it on the leg side but ends up playing all over it and gets hit on the pad. The ball-tracking seems to be taking some time. And when it eventually loads, it shows the ball would have hit the leg stump
bowled wide of the crease and wide of Cummins as well. He went for the cut but couldn't connect
a googly from outside off. Extra bounce too. Cummins adjusts and works it towards square leg
full around off. Samad goes for the slog but fails to middle it. Only a single to deep midwicket
full on the stumps. Turned towards square leg
Into the stands. Full outside off. Cummins smacks his lips and slogs it over long-on
length ball around off. Defended from the back foot
length ball but down the leg side
a length ball outside off. Cummins mistimes it into the ground, and it dribbles towards long-on
Hardik has his third. A length ball that came back in sharply to beat Jansen's wild swing and rattle the stumps. SRH in deep, deep trouble here
slower one but too wide outside off. Jansen lets it go. MI have reviewed it but it was just outside the wide guideline. MI lose their review
short and pulled down towards long leg
length outside off. Jansen goes over covers but he hasn't middle it. Bumrah at sweeper cover fields it
short of length outside off. Samad gets on his toes and dabs it behind point
And he has his second wicket. Full on the pads and Shahbaz goes aerial, towards long-on. But there's no timing or power behind it. SKY charges in and completes the catch with a slide
full on the stumps. Jansen clears his front leg and brings out the lap sweep to make it ten off the last two balls
too full and Jansen goes after it. Launches it over deep midwicket for a six. Even though it came from the toe end of the bat, there was enough behind it to take it all the way
length ball outside off. Goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the front pad
too full on the stumps. Swept behind square leg
full on the stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket
full around off. Shahbaz moves towards the leg side and flicks it in front of square leg. No one inside the 30-yard circle on the leg side, so Chawla himself had to chase
full outside off. Pushes towards mid-on
another short ball, once again angling down the leg side. An appeal for caught behind by Kishan but only to distract the umpire from giving it a wide. And he succeeds in it. SRH, too, don't review it
length ball on the stumps. Tucked away towards short midwicket
a bouncer but down the leg side. Jansen lets it go. MI have reviewed it. Replay shows that it may not have been too high but it was definitely down the leg side
a slower length ball. Shahbaz waits for it and drops it on the off side for a single
full around off. Driven firmly but straight to extra cover
length ball outside off. Dabbed behind point for one
length ball at the stumps. Goes back and punches it towards long-on. 100 up for SRH
A googly on good length ball outside off and spinning away from Shahbaz to beat his attempted cut
length outside off. Steered between the slip and short third for a couple
full outside off. Pushed towards long-on
length ball on the stumps. Worked towards square leg
bowled 'im! A quicker one - 91.9kph - and full on the stumps. Klaasen goes for the big shot but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. This is a big, big moment in the game
length ball outside off. Jansen chips it uppishly but it goes just to the left of mid-off. Kamboj puts in the chase to keep it to two
another short ball. Jansen goes for the pull but fails to connect
length outside off. Worked towards extra cover
short of length outside off. Pushes it to the right of point for one
beaten! A length ball outside off, holding it line. Jansen was rooted in his crease. He went for the drive and got beaten

short outside off. Reddy went for the pull only to sky it towards covers. It was too fast for him. Kamboj from point and Rohit from cover were converging. For a moment, it looked like both were going to leave it for the other but Kamboj grabs it in the end
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards long-on
full around off and Klaasen goes big. Didn't get the required power behind it and it fell to the left of David at long-off
slips in a googly first up. Was on the fuller side but Klaasen stayed back and just managed to keep it out
straight to Tilak at deep-backward square leg. Full on the stumps and Head goes for the slog sweep, only to hit it straight into the lap of the fielder
length ball at the stumps, Reddy whips it towards long-on
length ball on the stumps. Might have been a googly. Head goes back and punches it towards long-off
shuffles in his crease but hitting this length aerially to the right of mid-off. Didn't middle it, which means there's ample time for long-on to cut it off
length ball around off. Reddy comes forward but the ball moves just away, forcing Reddy to defend
length ball at the stumps. Goes back and pushes it towards sweeper cover
length ball angling in. Dabbed in front of square leg
beaten! Full outside off. Reddy comes forward and looks to drive but gets beaten as the ball just holds its line
length ball on the pads. Reddy flicks it to the left of fine leg and sprints back for the second
length outside off, dabbed towards deep third
length ball outside off and Reddy punches it in front of point but fine enough to beat a desperate dive from sweeper cover
length ball angling in. Worked towards deep midwicket
length ball outside off. Dabs it behind point for one
slightly fuller. Reddy pushes at it once more, gets an outside edge and it runs past the keeper for four
length ball outside off and moves just away to beat Reddy's push
length ball around off. Flicked behind square leg for one
full around off. Pushes it through midwicket for a couple

Finally! Finally, Anhsul Kamboj has an IPL wicket. Was a length ball that came in a touch. Agarwal had cleared his front leg and look to smash it on the leg side. He missed and the ball trimmed the bails
length ball angling in. Mayank looks to flick it away but don't think he got any bat on it. The ball drops towards the leg side off the thigh pad

dropped by Thushara! A length ball angling across. Head looks to go aerial down the ground but gets an outside edge that flies towards deep third, where Thushara never looked steady, tried to take it reverse cups and spilled it in the end
full on the stumps. Defended on the off side
full outside off and Agarwal smashes it through covers for four
length ball around off. Kept just a little bit low. Agarwal defends it from the crease
full at the stumps. Head mistimes it towards long-on
length ball at the stumps. Turned towards square leg
length ball at the stumps. Pushed through covers for one
a length ball on the stumps. Head hops and whips it over midwicket for four. His back foot, though, was precariously close to the stumps
full around off. Agarwal comes forward and looks to hit it through extra cover. Gets an inside edge in front of square leg

Bumrah strikes! A length ball around off, just holding its line. Abhishek pushes at it with little footwork, got an outside edge and Kishan dived to his left to take it with both hands - there was no slip in place
a full toss but Abhishek fails to take advantage of it. He tried to open the face of the bat but couldn't beat cover
short of length angling towards the batter. Abhishek dabs it towards backward point
length ball on the stumps. Head hops and flicks it towards deep square leg
length ball at the batter. As always, Head was moving towards leg side and just opens his face to work it towards short third where the fielder mis-fields and lets it go for four
full around off. Head was early into the shot. The ball hits the toe end of the bat and rolls towards square leg

Given it's a free hit, Kamboj cannot change the field and Head is taking advantage of that. Another full ball on the stumps. Head gives himself some room and hits it over mid-on to pick up another boundary. 50 also comes up for SRH
full on the stumps and Head launches it over mid-on for four. And guess what, Kamboj has overstepped once again. So another free hit is coming up

Kamboj gets his first IPL wicket. Full around off. Head exposes his stumps as he looks for another big hit. Misses and the off stump is out of the ground. But Kamboj's happiness is shortlived as the no-ball siren goes off. Luck seems to be on Head's side tonight
length ball angling him. Almost cramps him but Head clears his front leg and also moves towards the leg side to create just enough room to pull it towards deep midwicket
length ball outside off. Head backs away and looks to hit it through the off side. Gets beaten
length ball, too straight. Head pulls it in front of square leg and it flies all the way for a six - his first of the match
length ball around off. Head clears his front leg but ends up hitting straight towards mid-off
142.2kph. A length ball angling in. Abhishek was looking to push it on the leg side but gets beaten and struck on the leg
full outside off. Abhishek looks to drive it through covers, gets an inside edge onto his back leg
142.1kph. Full and swinging away - not exactly a yorker but full enough. Head pushes it towards mid-off
length ball at the stumps. Worked towards mid-on for another single
full outside off and swinging in at 140.5kph. Head jams his bat at it, gets an inside edge towards the keeper - on the  bounce
length ball angling in. Tucked away towards square leg
125.4kph. A slower bouncer. Head couldn't read and swung his bat well before the ball reached him. Got beaten
full around off. Head has figured out how to face Thushara. Drills him past mid-off and David from long-on had no chance this time
on the fuller side of good length and swinging in once more. Abhishek gets an inside edge onto the pads as he looks to flick it away
full and swinging in once again. Head hits it down the ground this time but Tim David sprints to his right from long-on to stop it just inside
full on the stumps. Head cleared his front leg and swung across but the ball swings in and beats his bat, and stumps
full on the pads and angling down. Abhishek misses the flick but collects a leg-bye
length ball around off. Head goes for the cut but it's too close to him. Gets an inside edge that once again goes past the stumps for four
length ball on the pads. Abhishek misses the flick but gets a leg-bye to deep-backward square leg
first six of the night. A length ball angling across. Abhishek stands tall and smashes it over extra cover, all the way for a six
139kph, a length ball outside off, angling across Abhishek. He pushes at it and gets beaten. Good bounce there too for Kamboj
length outside off. Chopped towards extra cover for one
short of length around off. Abhishek pushes at it and gets an outside edge behind point
he too starts with a wide. A length ball outside off and leaves the batter. Abhishek had a go at it but it was too far away from him
118.6kph. A slower one, full around off. Head swings across and gets an inside edge once again. Luckily for him, it goes past the stumps for four
length ball outside off. Head clears his front leg and looks to smash it on the leg side. The ball comes slower off the surface and hits the inner half. Dribbles towards short midwicket
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards mid-on
length ball angling in. Abhishek gets an inside edge towards square leg

comes down the ground but Thushara bowls this wide outside off - the ball landed behind the stumps. Tapan Sharma, the umpire, has given this a wide and now MI want to review it. And the replay shows it was withing the guideline

once again swinging down the leg side. This time the umpire doesn't rule it a wide but Abhishek has sent this for a review. It was too close to the pads, so I will be surprised if the on-field decision is overruled. Oh, the UltraEdge shows it brushed Abhishek's pad too. SRH lose their review
full but down the leg side. Swings further away from Head. Kishan does well to get a hand on it but cannot stop a bye. SRH 2/0 before the first legal ball is bowled

Low full toss has been tonked over the long-off boundary, SKY finishes off with a 51-ball hundred. Slower one too, he lunged and smeared it while maintaining control. Flat six, the ball boy there might've caught it. Not sure. SKY gets his lid off, raises his bat and soaks in the applause.
Almost a yorker, 132ks on middle stump, clipped to either deep square leg or midwicket

Three pulled boundaries off slower bouncers end the over. Match is all but sealed. Not a bad ball tbh, not sure how SKY middled that. Had no pace to work with but deposited it well into the stands over the square-leg boundary
Another pull. This was a better shot as the offcutter was a bouncer that rose to around neck-height. SKY collapsed his back and heaved it after delaying the shot a bit

Sower bouncer rises to only around waist-height. It's real wide and is pulled over midwicket. No one in the deep wide of square leg. Cummins stands with a double teapot as the equation comes down to 17 off 20
Slower bouncer from around the wicket is guided to deep third, off the back foot
Into the pitch again, slow again. It's outside off and SKY tries to pull it hard, underedges it below. Luckily for SKY it goes past leg stump to deep fine
Slower bouncer is wide, SKY goes across and tries to clatter it over point. Looked like he went too hard, made no contact. Wasn't far from the tramline but enough for wide to be called
Pitched up at the stumps from around the wicket, clipped to long-on
Pitched up, misses the yorker by a bit, but the batter can't connect with the flick. Ball deflects off the pad towards deep third
Hooked real fine. Bumper at 129ks at head-height, it was on leg and Tilak was deep in the crease. He swivelled and got one leg up in the process, middled it
Worked away to the off side
Goes for the sweep, gets a top edge but it goes far behind the keeper and lands safely. Was pitched up and at the stumps

Great placement, deep third runs to the right but it beats him. Was a back of lengther at chest-height, SKY was deep in the crease, crouched a bit and cut it wristily, had a small coil of the wrist in fact like in a helicopter shot
Shortish one lands on middle and angles away, beats the pull
Length on middle and leg, punched to long-on
Length outside off, punched to cover
Squarter sweep, absolutely off the middle. Four more. This was overpitched and on middle and leg, his upper body reached further forward and got it far to the left of deep-backward square
Down leg, too full as well and SKY sweeps it wide of short fine. Four along the ground
Flat on a back of length, top of middle and off height, worked to deep square leg
Fullish on leg, 91ks, clipped to deep midwicket
Back of length, just inside the off-side tramline, chopped to deep point
Slot ball has been mowed over long-on! Fifth-stump line and slow too, SKY bent both his legs and had a proper smite
Wide on a length, slapped to cover
SKY takes a step forward and almost collapses, there wasn't a run on as the ball went straight to cover, but not great signs for him. Was a fullish ball that was driven
Full around off, pushed to cover

Fullish ball at the stumps, tries to clip it square but gets it off the edge to the right of Jansen, coming in from cover. Jars his shoulder while diving and feels a bit of pain. Okay to continue though
Wide on a length, too wide. let go.
High-ish full bunger. 132ks. At the body, clipped to deep square leg. Not a no-ball, was around thigh-high
Full and slow from around the wicket, clipped to deep midwicket
Too full, drivable length and SKY powers it wide of mid-off. Finishes with a flourish, not nailed
Jansen's off-day is costing SRH big time. Overpitched and it's lifted down the ground. He holds the pose till the ball goes over the ropes after bouncing once
Bouncer, dug into the pitch proper. Tennis-ball bounce takes it over the head. Let go

Overpitched on fourth, the drive is up over the cover infield. Deep point runs to the right to cut it off. Batters take two and SKY brings up fifty, makes no secret of his sponsor, soaks in the appreciation by turning around fully
Length over middle, tapped with an open face to point. SKY manages to run without too much discomfort. He was stretching in between overs
Slower one on a fullish length. Fourth-stump line, nudged to midwicket
Whacks it from the line of the stumps to long-on

This full toss isn't left unpunished. Looks like another yorker missed, this is on top of the pad, SKY was inside the line and elevated the leg glance with a whip of the wrists to get it wide of deep fine leg
Wide on a fullish length, cut but not much more than a caress. To deep point it goes
Pulls a length ball while limboing. It didn't rise all that high, so Tilak had to get low, did so with his back arched and got it through midwicket
Full toss slips out, 128ks, just over the knee roll, clipped along the ground. SKY is limping and has a grimace as he completes the run. Looks in pain but will carry on
Fuller side of length, coming back in towards off, tries to chip it down the ground. Inside edges it to the thighs
Pitched right up on fifth, driven to long-off
Almost finds the edge Hard length, lands around off and goes away, SKY stays put in the crease and tries to run it to third.
The grip is as loose as it gets to help the overpitched ball through the gap in front of point.
Pitched up and SKY tries to go over extra, drives it off the bottom of the bat and gets enough for it to land safe. Mid-off goes across a few metres and keeps it to two
Cuffed down the ground, Jansen runs from long-on to long-off and puts in the big dive. Has he saved the boundary? Yeah, easy, he dive was diagonal in fact, could still palm it in
Are MI looking to see him off? Hard length over off, clipped into the pitch right in front
Further uppish but it skedaddles through the gap in front of point. Was pitched up on a wider line, SKY tried driving through cover, with the full flourish and all. Hovered low before hitting grass
Uppish cover drive, SKY doesn't check his shot until it's too late but it didn't lob up. Hit the ground soon and went to cover. Was a length ball outside off
Full outside off, driven to mid-off
Walks into the flick, gets the length ball to midwicket
Length in the channel, pushed to cover
Hard length on middle and leg, 138ks, clipped to midwicket
Length outside off, guided to point

Pulled while swivelling, gets it in the gap through deep-backward square. Fifty partnership up. Length ball on off, top-of-pad height, didn't rise much, Tilak does well to coil low and then in a circle to get it racing along the ground
Beaten on the punch through cover. Length ball gets good zip off the pitch and carry, Tilak tried to hit it on the up
Length on leg, clipped to midwicket
Length outside off, beats the square cut. Looked to have bounced lower than expected
Overpitched on middle, 137ks, driven to mid-off. Ump points to the watch

Might have straightened off the deck, hits the shoulder of the bat and goes to cover. Fuller side of length, lands on leg and SKY leant forward to either defend straight tor work to midwicket. Played softly
Yorker on middle, 128ks, good stuff. Tilak manages to not fall over while clipping it to deep square leg
Shorter but still on a length, clipped to midwicket
Length at the stumps, clipped to midwicket

MI keep turning it around, they did it with ball in hand and now with bat. Bit of a loosener first up, it was wide and fullish and Tilak creams the front-foot drive with the full follow-through. Races through cover
The line's too straight, makes it easier for SKY to pick it up. He's halfway into a squat and helps it over fine leg for a flatter six.
Drives the full ball outside off, driven to cover
Length on fifth, sslapped to deep point
SKYed over fine leg. Amazing. He went across to off stump early, got a length ball on middle, seemed like he went too far but still went through with the lofted ramp, the Supla if you will
Thumped down and along the ground. Cross-seam on a fullish length, angling away through sixth stump. SKY leant across and slapped it like Jansen was an fingerspinner
Whipped wide of of mid-on from the top of the bounce. The fact that it was a length ball going just above the pad made it more impressive
Back to jaffa mode but it's MI's over. Length ball lands around off and keeps going through the fifth-stump line, Tilak shapes to play before leaving
Glanced off middle and leg. Fuller side of length, lands on off and is angling in, easy enough for Tilak to angle it fine
Wide on a length, slapped to deep-backward point

Did SKY just make a leading edge look intentional? He was deep in the crease and tried to clip the thigh-high length ball - like Rohit did - with a closed bat face. He looked towards deep third instinctively as it sailed high and far.
Sanvir comes in from mid-on, gets low and fumbles. Bonus single. Dew might be playing a part already. Was a fullish ball that was clipped
This is like Bazball almost. Cummins nails his length again, gets it towards off with the angle bringing it in, but Tilak danced down and flayed it through cover. Disdain
Length on fourth, defended to cover
Driven from well in front of the body, SKY leans forward and drives it straight of mid-off. Fullish on off, SKY got his front leg from outside leg towards the line and eased it through
Length around off, defended to cover

Huge, huge lbw appeal. Bhuvi's going even as the batter almost completes a run. Not given. A review promptly follows. Where is it pitching and is it too high? Length ball that beat the flick. Ball-tracking comes up, it's pitching just outside leg.
Missed it by a week, as Pommie Mbangwa calls it. Length ball lands around, decks away and Tilak shaped to defend towards cover

Naman tries to hit out of trouble and ends up flashing it to first slip. Shortish, around fifth stump, he charged down and tried to slash it over point. He couldn't account for the bounce and got it off the edge. Jansen took it around head-height, would've been four if a normie was standing there
At the body, hits the body. Hard length, at the thigh, beats the flick and deflects forward. Maiden
Cummins has it on a string! Keeps bashing it into the pitch and holding the channel-line. SKY tries to punch it defensively but can't get bat on it
Pulls his length back and goes about a stump wider, still beaten
Another jaffa! Perfect length, around that seven-metre mark, line's around off stump too. Straightens and SKY tried to defend it straight. Beaten on the outside edge. What a ball to get first up

Leading edge, right up, Klaasen clears coast and takes it well! Cummins has Rohit again, fourth time informs Ian Bishop on air. Bashed on a length into the pitch, scramble-seam ball landed around middle and off and straightened just a bit. Rohit's idea of staying in the crease and helping it square with a closed bat face seemed reasonable, but the movement off the pitch did him in. Klaasen didn't have to travel much but had to wait a while before it came down. Was right below and took it with gloves pointing up
Fullish at the stumps, 136ks, clipped to midwicket
Fullish but the line's wider, punched firmly to cover point. Scrambled seam, went straight off the pitch. Naman unhappy on not piercing the gap but he handled the ball and the over well
Fullish on fifth, 137ks, pushed to cover
Edge found, half-volleys to second slip. Test stuff. 134ks on a length, fourth stump, Naman defending with soft hands but was searching a bit. Rohit gives him a thumbs up
Pitched up just outside off, pushed to cover

Cuts Naman in half, beats the keeper too. Proper jaffa. Seam's upright, lands on a length around fourth stump and decks in to go over off. Naman tries to cover the line and play straight but got beaten on the inside edge, bottom hand came off. Ball zipped off the pitch and kept angling wide to the left of the keeper
Better start from Bhuvi. Length on fourth, 136ks, defended with bat close to the body, to cover
Tad back of length on the pads, beats the flick and deflects towards point
Full on sixth, pushed to cover

Jansen turns into both a can opener and an artist to have Kishan caught at slip! 137ks on a fullish length, shaped to come in before deceiving oh so sweetly. Seam-movement deluxe. Kishan tried to clip it square but got it off the leading edge. Mayank takes it in front of his chest
Glanced fine. Looked like there was seam movement off a length, landed around off and finished on the thigh pad. Beats the flick and deflects fine
Carved. Wide on a slight back of length, 137, there was away movement and Kishan used it to his advantage by freeing his arms and flashing with power
Length on off, blocked towards cover
More wides. The starting line on this itself was wide, it swerved away further and Kishan tried helping it fine. Ball beat not only him but also the diving keeper. Bonus
Down leg to the right hander this time. Rohit tries to glance it, misses, it grazes the pad along the way
Plan B from Rohit is to dance down and bouge it over wide mid-on. Hard length, 139ks, just outside off but he heaved it over the infield. Proper power
Rohit pokes and misses. Outswinger on a length, around sixth stump and the batter just wanted a feel, went with an open face.
Kishan wanted two but decided against it as the throw from Shahbaz came in quickly. Short boundary there. Was a length ball around fourth that was pushed with an open face to deep third
Off the pads, wide of the keeper. Bhuvi looks to swing this inwards after trying to away first ball. Kishan goes for another flick, didn't need to connect
On the pads and it's clipped through square leg. Looking for swing, getting it on the fuller side of length but it slides on comfortably for Kishan
